about: A name as the record wrote it -> the full name of the person it is. Only first-name-only entries and typos. "Markus" is Markus Johansen and "Are Tommerås" is Are Tømmerås (the record's spelling is kept), both saints. Left out on purpose until decided: William, Henrik, Kasper, Eirik, Erik, Kristian, Magnus byrkj, Sofie. The key is compared case-insensitively.
